Privacy Policy

Last updated: October 30, 2026

LTC ERA respects user privacy. This policy explains how information may be collected, used and protected when you access our website and services.

Information We May Collect

  • Account details such as your name, email address and contact information.
  • Information you submit when contacting support.
  • Basic technical information such as browser type, device information and website activity.
  • Relevant transaction and account records when you use payment-related features.

How We Use Information

Information may be used to operate the platform, manage accounts, provide support, maintain security, process applicable transactions and improve our services.

Sharing of Information

We do not intend to sell personal information. Information may be shared with service providers where necessary to operate the platform, or where disclosure is required by applicable law or necessary to protect users and platform security.

Data Security

We take reasonable measures to protect information. However, no online system can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

Your Choices

You should keep your login credentials confidential and contact platform support if you believe your account has been accessed without permission.

Policy Updates

This policy may be updated when our services or legal requirements change. The latest version will be published on this page.
